metadata.title: iOS Shortcut Configuration Guide - RemoveGeminiWatermark
metadata.description: Learn how to create an iOS shortcut to remove AI watermarks from Gemini-generated images directly from the share menu.

title: iOS Shortcut Guide
description: By integrating our API into iOS Shortcuts, you can remove watermarks directly from the Photos share menu. No need to open a browser, process images anytime, anywhere.

step1.title: Setup Share Sheet
step1.description: In the Shortcut's Details page, toggle 'Show in Share Sheet'.
step1.details: Set 'Receive Types' to 'Images' only. This keeps your share menu clean when sharing text or links.

step2.title: Handle Input Logic
step2.description: Add logic to ensure the shortcut works both from the share sheet and directly.
step2.details: Use 'Get Shortcut Input' as the first step. Add an 'If' condition: if Shortcut Input has no value, add 'Select Photos' step.

step4.title: Output and Save
step4.description: After the server returns the cleaned image, add saving actions.
step4.details: Add 'Save to Photo Album' and 'Show Result' to complete the workflow.

tips.tip1: Pro users can use the shortcut without rate limits or anonymity counters (requires passing an auth token in the URL).
tips.tip2: Currently supports original Gemini-generated images. Non-Gemini images might not be processed correctly.
